# Vista Chase

> Vista Chase runs small-group and private tours and shuttles in Banff National Park and the Canadian Rockies, with hotel pickup in Banff, Canmore and Lake Louise.

Boutique Canadian Rockies tour operator based in Canmore, Alberta. Ranked #6 Experience in Canada by TripAdvisor Travellers' Choice Best of the Best 2026. Official Parks Canada commercial access permits for Moraine Lake and Lake Louise.

## Key Tours and Services

- [Shared Small-Group Tours](https://vistachase.com/shared-tours): Small-group sightseeing with a maximum of 12 guests and doorstep hotel pickup in Banff and Canmore.
- [Banff & Yoho Discovery Tour](https://vistachase.com/banff-highlights-tour): Full-day award-winning tour visiting Lake Louise, Moraine Lake, Emerald Lake, Natural Bridge, and Johnston Canyon. CAD $220/guest.
- [Columbia Icefield Adventure](https://vistachase.com/shared-tours-icefields-jasper): Full-day excursion along the Icefields Parkway with stops at Bow Lake, Peyto Lake, and included Ice Explorer glacier experience. CAD $320/guest (summer).
- [Two-Day Rockies Explorer](https://vistachase.com/two-day-rockies-explorer): Combined 2-day package covering Banff, Yoho, and the Icefields Parkway with 10% savings.
- [Private Luxury Tours](https://vistachase.com/private-tours): Private vehicle tours for up to 13 guests, tailored itineraries, and optional roundtrip Calgary Airport (YYC) transfers.
- [Three-Day Rockies Discovery](https://vistachase.com/three-day-rockies-discovery): Multi-day private exploration across Banff, Lake Louise, Moraine Lake, Yoho, and the Columbia Icefield with manual date selection.
- [Four-Day Rockies & Jasper](https://vistachase.com/four-day-rockies-and-jasper): Extended four-day private journey through Banff, Yoho, Columbia Icefield, and Jasper National Park.
- [Moraine Lake & Lake Louise Shuttles](https://vistachase.com/shuttles): Direct transportation with guaranteed Moraine Lake road access, early morning sunrise departures, and convenient pickup from Canmore, Banff, and Samson Mall.
- [Plan Your Trip](https://vistachase.com/plan-your-trip): Interactive trip planner with From and To date selection, guest party size, and personalized recommendations.

## Policies and Details

- [Good to Know & FAQ](https://vistachase.com/faq): Inclusions, what to wear, pickup timings, park pass requirements, and seasonal conditions.
- [Cancellation Policy](https://vistachase.com/privacy-policy-vista-chase): Free cancellation up to 72 hours before departure for standard single-day tours and shuttles. Flexible cancellation for multi-day bookings.
- [About Vista Chase](https://vistachase.com/about-us): Local guide profiles, fleet specifications, and sustainability commitments.
